sentences.text: The present second bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant in Case Crime No. 112 of 2015, under Section 498A, 304B of IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Meja, District Allahabad(Prayagraj) with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

sentences.text: It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
sentences._hearing_file: Dinesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 17 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is submitted that the statement of PW-1 was recorded on 02.08.2017 thereafter this witness did not turn up for examination before the court.
sentences._hearing_file: Dinesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 17 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: Further it is submitted that the trial of the case is under progress, vide supplementary affidavit, the order sheet of the trial court is also filed.
sentences._hearing_file: Dinesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 17 January, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is further submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 10.06.2015. having no criminal history and that in case he is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Dinesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 17 January, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Per contra, the learned Additional Government Advocate has opposed the prayer for grant of bail Dinesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 17 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121067663/
1 and argued that on 02.08.2017 PW-1 was present in the court but no cross-examination was done on behalf of the applicant for want of his counsel and the opportunity to cross-examine the witness has been closed by the court concerned.
Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties, period of incarceration and the fact that only one witness has been recorded so far, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
